shared_elements: schematic boat/ship with upturned prow and stern
crew shown as vertical stroke-lines along the hull
small schematic human figures with outstretched arms
rows of repeated short strokes or cupmarks
figures with raised arms holding or near an object
large panel of scattered carvings on rock surface
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive repertoire: long schematic boats with in-curving prow/stern and crew rendered as a row of vertical strokes along the hull, accompanied by small stick-like human figures with raised or outstretched arms, discs/circles and rows of repeated small marks, drawn with the same flat outline-and-stroke convention on an open rock panel. The chief difference is emphasis and relationship: A is dominated by one huge boat with the human figures small and peripheral, while B foregrounds large striding/limbed human figures with a big circle beside them, the boats being relegated to the upper zone.
